findings.comparison: Unchanged: eligible travellers receive SGD 500 at 48 hours or more abroad, otherwise SGD 100. Excluded passes and crew remain excluded; liquor, tobacco and commercial goods do not qualify.
Unchanged: age 18+, at least 48 hours abroad, not arriving from Malaysia, own consumption, non-prohibited goods. The same five allowed combinations remain; two litres of spirits alone is not one.
Unchanged: no duty-free or GST allowance; age 21+, personal-use packaging requirements and 400g maximum remain separate from taxation. Vapes remain prohibited.
Unchanged: separate ownership/re-export conditions; newly purchased items do not qualify merely because used during travel.
Preserve 2019-02-19 GST and 2019-04-01 liquor effective dates. Retrieval and webpage update dates are not new effective dates.
